assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229
The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
These are intermittent symptoms, so inpatient monitoring is not appropriate and out-of-office monitoring is the medically necessary setting
This appeal addresses denial code CO-197 on medical necessity grounds
